verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs list an 'Embeddings & Reranking' offering with 'state-of-the-art embedding and reranker models for search and RAG', and name embeddings as a core model category on the same inference cloud. That covers both halves of the story from a single vendor, but the evidence is headline-level only. Missing for 10: embeddings/rerank API endpoint documentation (e.g., an OpenAI-compatible embeddings call or rerank request format), named models, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
